response.sql: SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE -t.amount END) AS avg_signed_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.amount >= 2400 AND t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') GROUP BY a.account_id, a.frequency ORDER BY avg_balance DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: trans.amount is stored unsigned (per the verified note), so the threshold amount >= 2400 applies to the stored value and direction comes only from trans.type.

Only 'PRIJEM' and 'VYDAJ' rows are kept, so the 'average balance after those transactions' is taken over the same filtered rows used for the signed average. VYBER and other types are excluded throughout, as the request says.
statement frequency comes from account.frequency, and accounts with no qualifying transactions are omitted by the inner join.
Ties at the 10th-highest average balance are not broken by any secondary key, so the cutoff row may be ambiguous when values are equal.
